topic: Chacha Jee opens the electricity bill.

episode.title: Chacha Jee Ka Ek Plug Wala Formula!

shots.narration: بجلی کا بل آیا، چاچا کی مونچھیں بھی ہل گئیں!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani living room, sunny yellow walls, patterned sofa, vertical 9:16, polished 3D animated comedy look; bill paper faces away from camera, no visible text or symbols.
shots.action: Chacha opens a folded electricity bill with dramatically widened eyes.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, trembling moustache, warm sunny colours.

shots.narration: پھر بولے، بچت کا اصل طریقہ مجھے آتا ہے!
shots.scene: Same bright living room beside a wall socket, vertical 9:16, polished 3D animation, no text or logos.
shots.action: Chacha raises one finger confidently beside an attentive Pappu.
shots.mood: Chacha beams proudly; Pappu watches with patient curiosity.

shots.narration: پپو، وہ زیادہ سوراخوں والا بورڈ لاؤ!
shots.scene: Same living room, open floor beside the sofa, vertical 9:16, polished 3D animation; plain unmarked power strip, no text.
shots.action: Pappu presents a three-socket power strip in both hands.
shots.mood: Pappu wears a small, questioning smile.

shots.narration: تین پنکھے، مگر دیوار میں پلگ صرف ایک!
shots.scene: Same living room with three small pedestal fans and a wall-connected power strip, two fan plugs already inserted, vertical 9:16, no text or logos.
shots.action: Chacha inserts the third fan plug into the power strip.
shots.mood: Chacha grins triumphantly while Pappu raises an eyebrow.

shots.narration: چاچا سمجھے، اب بل بھی ایک پنکھے کا آئے گا!
shots.scene: Same sunny living room, three running pedestal fans aimed toward the sofa, curtains blowing, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chacha reclines on the sofa in the combined breeze.
shots.mood: Eyes closed, satisfied smile, waistcoat fluttering comically.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، چاچا، تینوں پنکھے بجلی تو کھائیں گے!
shots.scene: Same living room with three running fans and their cables leading to one power strip, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Pappu points toward the three occupied power-strip sockets.
shots.mood: Pappu looks patiently explanatory; Chacha keeps a stubbornly confident smile.

shots.narration: چاچی آئیں، اور سارا فارمولا بند کر دیا!
shots.scene: Same living room, wall socket clearly visible beside the sofa, three fans in the background, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Chachi pulls the power strip's single plug from the wall socket.
shots.mood: Chachi looks calmly decisive; Chacha's smile drops.

shots.narration: بولیں، یہ پنکھا چلاؤ، بل بالکل نہیں بڑھے گا!
shots.scene: Same sunny living room, stationary electric fans behind the sofa, vertical 9:16; plain woven hand fan without writing.
shots.action: Chachi places a woven hand fan into Chacha's hand.
shots.mood: Chachi smiles sweetly; Chacha stares at the fan in disbelief.

shots.narration: اب چاچا ہوا دیں گے، اگلی بار استری کی باری!
shots.scene: Same bright living room, Chachi seated comfortably beside Pappu, ironing board with rumpled clothes and an unplugged plain iron nearby, vertical 9:16, no text or logos.
shots.action: Chacha fans the comfortably seated Chachi with the woven hand fan.
shots.mood: Chachi wears a victorious smile; Pappu suppresses a giggle; Chacha's moustache d

episode.endHook: Agli baar kapron ki istri, aur Chacha Jee ki nayi tarkeeb!
episode.description: بجلی کا بل دیکھ کر چاچا جی نے بچت کا انوکھا نسخہ نکالا۔ مگر چاچی جان کے ایک فیصلے نے سارا حساب بدل دیا!
